source_title: State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations
period_class: supplementary post-period observation, not full main-report window
rounding_caveat: Reported bins total 99.9%; do not force 100% or add a synthetic residual. Missing-parameter fraction is printed as 26%, so its precision differs.
threshold_conflict: Blog prose says above 100B takes 1%; chart says Over 70B=1.0%. Do not claim these are interchangeable.
csv_method: Human transcription of exact numeric labels, visually checked against immutable original PNG and current larger PNG; values are not estimated from bar geometry.
